answer: Mint an identity by proving sequential delay: (1) a node grinds a 72-hour VDF chained to the epoch's beacon — one core, no shortcut; (2) the output hashed with its key becomes a non-transferable credential; (3) a public atlas of mints exposes duplicate keys; (4) each epoch demands a fresh run, so a credential is a single-use relic. 1,000 sybils cost 72,000 core-hours (~$2,160 at $0.03/core-hour) plus 72 hours wall-clock each — money can't compress the delay. Sybils spread like yarrow: every fragment regrows a plant, so don't pull clones — each crown must grow from seed for a season.
